notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Illusory Ambusher indestructible.
You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Give Illusory Ambusher indestructible by any method.
Draw a card by any method.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to Illusory Ambusher.
Illusory Ambusher triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.
